Retrieved via Exa 19 July 2026.

SUNDAY 19 JULY (overnight into Sunday):
- Russia launched its largest number of ballistic missiles since the start of the war against Kyiv early Sunday (Ukrainian FM Sybiha: "around four dozen"). Total: 41 missiles (including 25 ballistic) and 125 drones across Ukraine (Ukrainian Air Force). Ukraine downed 18 of 41 missiles and 108 drones. AP/NPR: Ukraine shot down at least 17-18 ballistic missiles, indicating it may have replenished some of its dwindling Patriot interceptor stockpile.
- Kyiv: one person killed, at least 16 wounded; fires across six districts (Sviatoshynskyi, Shevchenkivskyi, Solomyanskyi, Desnianskyi, Dnipro); residential buildings, offices, industrial sites, a dormitory and vehicles damaged.
- Russian drones also hit Dnipropetrovsk (one killed) and struck a passenger train in Zaporizhia region, killing its conductor.
- Domestic tensions high over Zelensky's removal of Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov in a cabinet reshuffle - street protests; some critics call it "the worst mistake of his presidency."
- Ukraine said its forces struck two Russian oil tankers in the Black Sea (continuing campaign to starve Crimea of fuel/supplies).
- Trump has said he is prepared to grant Ukraine licences to produce Patriot interceptor missiles domestically; details/timeline unclear.

QUOTES:
- Ukrainian FM Andrii Sybiha (X): "a brutal terrorist attack on the Ukrainian capital"; "We need devastating pressure on Moscow to end this terror"; called Putin "The coward in Moscow, who is afraid to meet with President Zelensky to end the war."
- President Zelensky (X, Sunday): "protection against ballistic missiles is our constant and top priority right now"; "Interceptors are needed every day."
